file_insights.changes_summary: Added 120 lines of accessible modal helper code with focus management and keyboard navigation
key_additions: accessibleModal Alpine.js data component with focus trapping
Focus restoration to trigger element on close
Tab key handling for focus cycling within modal
Escape key handling for modal dismissal

patterns_discovered.description: Store and restore focus to trigger element when modal opens/closes, enabling keyboard users to return to activation point
Prevent focus from leaving modal by cycling to last focusable element when Tab pressed at end, and first element when Shift+Tab pressed at beginning
Query and cache focusable elements (a, button, input, textarea, select, tabindex) with hidden element filtering on modal open
Use $watch for state changes, $nextTick for DOM readiness, and $el for modal element reference

patterns_discovered.pattern: Body Class Toggle for Modal State
patterns_discovered.description: Add/remove 'modal-open' class on body element to coordinate styling and prevent background scrolling

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Hidden Elements Not Excluded in Selector
gotchas_discovered.description: Focusable selector queries may return hidden elements; code correctly filters with offsetParent !== null check
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Implemented offsetParent check to exclude display:none and visibility:hidden elements

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: DOM May Not Be Ready When Modal Opens
gotchas_discovered.description: Focus management and focusable element detection requires modal to be rendered; code uses $nextTick to ensure proper timing
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: onOpen() wraps element updates in $nextTick before focusing

gotchas_discovered.description: Modal with only one focusable element needs Tab handling to prevent focus loss; code prevents default and keeps focus on element
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: handleTabKey prevents default when only 1 focusable element exists

gotchas_discovered.description: If modal was opened programmatically without trigger, restoring focus could fail; code checks existence before focusing
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: onClose checks triggerElement existence and callable before restoring focus

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No Escape Key on Modal Overlay Click
gotchas_discovered.description: Implementation handles Escape key but not overlay/backdrop click dismissal; requires separate click handler integration
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Escape key handler provided; overlay click handling should be added in consuming code

approach_outcome.objective: Create accessible modal Alpine.js helper with focus management
approach_outcome.implementation_strategy: Built Alpine.js data component with comprehensive focus trapping and keyboard navigation support
key_accomplishments: Focus management lifecycle (save on open, restore on close)
Tab key trapping with forward/backward navigation
Dynamic focusable element detection with visibility filtering
Single and zero focusable element edge cases handled
Body class state management for styling coordination
approach_outcome.test_coverage: Not explicitly shown in session data, but keyboard navigation and focus management logically testable

recommendations.recommendation: Add overlay click handler integration in consuming code
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation only handles Escape key; backdrop click is common modal dismissal pattern

recommendations.recommendation: Test focus trapping with assistive technology (screen readers)
recommendations.rationale: Focus management is critical for accessibility; should verify ARIA announcements work correctly

recommendations.recommendation: Document expected HTML structure and required attributes
recommendations.rationale: Focus selector relies on specific element types and attributes; consumers need clear integration guidance
Semantic markup and ARIA attributes improve accessibility for screen readers

recommendations.recommendation: Debounce or cache focusable element queries if modal content changes frequently
recommendations.rationale: updateFocusableElements queries DOM on every Tab key; significant updates could be optimized
